quiz.q: Where do you install the Hyperskill Academy plugin from inside IntelliJ?
quiz.explain: Search Hyperskill Academy in the Marketplace tab, install it and restart. Logging in is under Settings, Tools, Hyperskill.

quiz.q: What do you click on hyperskill.org to open a stage in IntelliJ?
options: Solve in IDE on the IDE tab
quiz.explain: Solve in IDE hands the stage to the running plugin, which opens the project.

quiz.q: You click the green Run triangle and the output looks right. Is the stage done on Hyperskill?
options: No, only Check runs the tests and counts
Only if you also press Reset
quiz.explain: Run only runs your program. Check runs Hyperskill's tests.

quiz.q: The task asks for Today: legs. What does Check say about this code?
quiz.explain: The program runs, but the tests compare the output exactly, including the capital T.

quiz.q: You paste this into a Hyperskill project (JDK 23) and press Check. What happens?
options: Compile error: implicitly declared classes are a preview feature
It prints Today: legs and fails one test
quiz.explain: Compact source files are a preview in Java 23 and final in Java 25. In a Hyperskill project, use the classic class and main.

quiz.q: What does java Hello.java (JDK 25) give for this file?
options: can't find main(String[]) or main() method in class: Hello
class Hello is public, should be declared in a file named Main.java
quiz.explain: Java is case-sensitive: Main is a different method than main, so there is no starting point.

quiz.q: Which button throws away your changes in a task and brings back the starting code?
quiz.explain: Reset drops all task changes so you can start again.

quiz.q: Which shortcut hides or shows Project View on a Mac?
quiz.explain: Cmd+1 (Alt+1 on Windows) toggles the Project tool window. Cmd+Shift+F12 hides all panels at once.

quiz.q: Which JDK should a Hyperskill project in IntelliJ use, and which Gym Log?
quiz.explain: Hyperskill's projects and checks are set up for JDK 23; Gym Log is where you use JDK 25.

flashcards.front: What is the Hyperskill Academy plugin?

flashcards.front: Where do you log in to the Hyperskill Academy plugin?
flashcards.back: Settings, Tools, Hyperskill, Log in to Hyperskill.

flashcards.front: Which button on hyperskill.org opens a stage in IntelliJ?
flashcards.back: Solve in IDE, on the IDE tab.

flashcards.front: What must be running before Solve in IDE works?
flashcards.back: IntelliJ with the Hyperskill Academy plugin.

flashcards.front: What does Project View show in a Hyperskill project?
flashcards.back: The stages and tasks as a tree, with your source files.

flashcards.front: Which panel holds the task text and the Check button?

flashcards.back: It runs Hyperskill's tests on your code and records the result.

flashcards.front: What does the green Run triangle do in a Hyperskill project?
flashcards.back: It only runs your program; nothing is graded.
Throws away your changes and restores the starting code.

Why does IO.println fail in a Hyperskill project?
